accuracy.cooling_tower_plume: CONDENSING WATER VAPOUR only — bright white/pale blue, soft-edged. Never smoke, soot, exhaust, storm cloud, or lightning. A fission plant burns nothing.
accuracy.power_flow: steady glowing conductors and cable runs. NEVER lightning bolts or electrical arcing. Do not use the word 'arcs' in any prompt — it renders as lightning.
accuracy.three_mile_island: TWO towers. Unit 2 = the 1979 meltdown; Unit 1 = the undamaged twin being restarted. Never depict the melted unit restarting.

sides.query_flow: LEFT-to-RIGHT. The human/question side is always LEFT; the machine/infrastructure side is always RIGHT. This matches the shipped thumbnail (phone lower-left, machine right) — packaging and video share one axis.
sides.power_flow: RIGHT-to-LEFT. Electricity travels from generation (right) back through the grid to the datacenter and finally the phone (left). Demand goes right; power comes back left. Never cross these.
sides.scale_ladder: Every rung UP the dazzle ladder (rack -> plant -> fab -> nation -> reactor) is a PULL-BACK, never a push-in. Pushing in means 'look closer at this'; pulling back means 'it is bigger than you thought'.
sides.training_vs_running: training = LEFT bar, running/inference = RIGHT bar (scenes 52-53)

continuity_registry.maps: north up; terrain in graphite #2A3240, unlit; the active region carries accent #4DA3FF and nothing else does
